content.title:
The University of Pennsylvania is home to a thriving urban forest. Penn boasts more than 6,500 woody plants, with more than 240 tree species spread throughout a dense urban landscape. The trees and vegetation provide tremendous ecological and environmental benefits for people and wildlife. They reduce pollution, sequester carbon, provide shade, and improve the mental and physical health for Penn's campus and beyond. The diversity of species, sizes, and colors means there's always something beautiful to catch your eye as you walk through campus.
